sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
## Introduction

Hello classmate, welcome to Labex. Now, let's see your new friend Linux. Try to print "Hello Linux" in the terminal.

### Achievements

- `echo` - print a string to the terminal.

sections.title: Print Hello Linux
sections.content:
## Print Hello Linux

This challenge is to print "Hello Linux" in the terminal.

### Requirements

- must use the `echo` command.
- must print **Hello Linux**, note the capitalization.

sections.content:
## Summary

Congratulations, you have completed the challenge.

In this challenge, you use the `echo` command to say hello to your friend Linux.

Keep exploring!
